name: payments-upi
title: UPI QR payments (India, no gateway)
summary: Server-priced payment records, a scannable UPI QR with per-app deep links on phones, UTR submission with one-use enforcement, and manual reconciliation.
when: Collecting money in India without a payment gateway: event tickets, stall fees, donations, small orders paid to a business UPI ID.
env: # Public by nature (printed on every QR). The UPI ID money is paid to.
next: Apply supabase/migrations/*_upi_payments.sql and set VITE_UPI_PAYEE_ADDRESS / VITE_UPI_PAYEE_NAME.

From the route that records an order, call createPayment(env, { purpose, amountRupees }) and send the payer to a page that GETs /api/payments?ref= and renders <UpiQrPayment amount reference /> and <UtrForm reference />.
Test on real Android and iOS phones with real UPI apps before launch. A launched app is never proof of payment.
